extracted.intended_audience: poets and writers submitting work to Poetry (Poetry Foundation) magazine
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting poems, prose, visual/audio/video work, and letters to the editor to Poetry (Poetry Foundation), including eligibility, submission procedure, payment, rights, and response expectations. Focused on prospective contributors using Submittable or mail alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: One submission at a time per category
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send only one submission at a time per category, and wait until you hear back from us before uploading a new submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a strict request: if you send multiple submissions they will be archived unread and will receive no response. The policy is intended to give ample time and space for everyone’s voices to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple submissions archived unread (penalty)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you do send multiple submissions, they will be archived unread and will receive no response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to bypass the single-submission request; ignored/mishandled multiple submissions will not be read.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response time / patience expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Due to the number of submissions we receive each year, we will likely get back to you within eight months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They note a small staff reads over 150,000 poems per year; plan for wait times up to 8 months and do not re-submit while awaiting a response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission platform: use Submittable
rubrics_metrics.description: We use Submittable to receive content for Poetry. Please visit our Submittable page for our full submission guidelines and open calls for work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot use Submittable (poetry.submittable.com) and would like to submit by mail, follow the mail submission instructions; if you cannot use Submittable for other reasons, email [email protected] with name and contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mail submissions: SASE required
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot use Submittable and would like to submit your work by mail, please send your submission to 61 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 and include a self-addressed return envelope.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you do not include a return envelope, your submission will not receive a response. Mail is an alternate option only; follow address and SASE rule exactly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: previously unpublished work only
rubrics_metrics.description: We consider only previously unpublished work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that has appeared online for any reason, including social media posts, is considered to have been previously published and should not be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous submissions permitted with notification
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry is open to simultaneous submissions, but let us know immediately if work is accepted elsewhere by adding a note to your submission specifying the work that is no longer available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may submit the same item elsewhere, but you must update the submission promptly if it is accepted for publication elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compensation rates for published work
rubrics_metrics.description: All poets will be compensated for published poems. For text poems, we pay $10/line with a minimum honorarium of $300 per poem. For visual poems, audio poems, and video poems, we pay $300 per poem. For prose, we pay $150 per published page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a piece is published in multiple formats (e.g., print and video), Poetry pays for each format. These are guaranteed baseline rates and apply to accepted pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry pays contributors via ACH, wire transfer, check, or JPay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be prepared to receive payment by one of these methods; contact the magazine if you have questions about payment options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights acquired by the magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry acquires first serial rights and non-exclusive reprint rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can reprint their work as they'd like after it has appeared in the magazine; Poetry's acquisition is limited to first serial and non-exclusive reprint rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical/contact instructions (email whitelist & support)
rubrics_metrics.description: To make sure you receive our response, set your spam filter to allow emails from [email protected]. If you’re having technical issues with Submittable, please contact [email protected].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need alternative submitting options or assistance, contact [email protected] and include your name and contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters to the Editor: desired content
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry is looking for thought-provoking responses to work published in the magazine, as well as letters that raise new questions about the state of contemporary poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters should engage with published work or broader issues in contemporary poetry in a way that provokes thought or new questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters to the Editor: submission process and editorial handling
rubrics_metrics.description: To send a letter to the editor, fill out the form provided. If we choose to use your letter, we will notify you by phone. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of sending your letter, you may assume we will not be using it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All letters may be edited for length and clarity, and may appear online, in print, or both. Expect possible edits and cross-format publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of acceptable formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry accepts text poems, visual poems, audio poems, video poems, and prose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different formats have specific pay rates; if a piece appears in multiple formats, it will be paid per format. Check Submittable/open calls for any special format requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archival and back-issue access information
rubrics_metrics.description: You can read issues of Poetry for free or order an individual back issue from our archive; print and digital subscriptions are also available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is informational for contributors and readers wanting to review the magazine's past content before submitting.
